sentence: This project builds tools that probe protein kinases and uses them to study how immune cells and cancer cells interact.
This project studies how a transcription factor that regulates gene expression drives inflammation in monocytes and macrophages in lupus.
This project tries to find out what causes oral cancer by studying changes in chromatin brought about by an enzyme.
This project sets up how data is collected, checked and shared for a study of peanut allergic children undergoing desensitization treatment.
This project keeps a partnership between institutions running so it can keep working to reduce cancer disparities.
This project sets up a service that helps researchers involve community members and other stakeholders in maternal and reproductive health research.
This project tests a genome editing technology based on CRISPR in a non-human primate model to eliminate HIV viruses from myeloid cells in the brain.
This project tests radiotracers for imaging aggregated alpha synuclein in Parkinson's disease and other synucleinopathies.
This project studies how gut bacteria affect immune checkpoint molecules in colorectal cancer using a bioengineered model.
This project builds imaging that uses quantitative MRI to detect and describe prostate tumors accurately.
This project looks for circular RNAs linked to Alzheimer's disease and studies what one of them does.
This project builds software for modeling, simulating and visualizing molecular systems and cells.
This project works to bring cancer education, screening and care services to American Indian Alaska Native communities.
This project tests whether artificial intelligence can classify polyps in endoscopic images during colonoscopy and show results to endoscopists using augmented reality.
This project builds software and tools that describe how the cells within a tumor differ.
This project studies how a part of the brain called the insula drives alcohol drinking and anxiety in female and male rats.
This project studies which nerve circuits in the dorsal horn cause mechanical allodynia after different types of injuries.
This project develops a method to deliver immune therapies in a targeted way in heart transplantation so they work better and are less toxic.
This project studies how latent HIV reservoirs cause inflammation in adolescents infected perinatally, using organoid models.
This project uses structural biology to study machines that edit genes and tries to reengineer them into more accurate tools.
